business_summary: Zhengyuan Zhihui Group Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of solutions and service operators for smart campuses in China. It offers higher education solutions, such as library, digital twin, data platform and data governance, teaching, space, apartment, student affairs, internet of things platform, portal and one-stop online services, laboratories, catering, and green campus solutions. The company also provides basic education solutions, including education supervision, admissions, evaluation, canteen, administrative office, campus card management, home-school communication, teacher and student management, academic affairs management, fee collection management, self-service, data application, and smart entry and exit solutions. In addition, it offers government and enterprise solutions comprising office, restaurant, security, parking, online store, park access card, energy, and property services; and cloud service solutions for smart campuses and smart parks. Further, the company provides air conditioners, hot water operations, vending machines, door locks, printing machine operation, direct drinking water operation, hair dryer, integrated operations, charging station operation, and washing machine and operational service solutions. Additionally, it offers services to government, military, police, and enterprises, forming smart park and industry industries. Zhengyuan Zhihui Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
